_about: What's changed in Jarvis and what's planned, shown in the dashboard's Changes tab and the 9am morning report. Update it with every change: add to 'done' (newest first) and move or add items in 'planned'.

done.title: No tasks you didn't ask for
done.detail: Claude Code no longer schedules reminders, check-ins, routines or suggested tasks on its own when working on Jarvis; it asks first.

done.title: Agents keep going on long jobs
done.detail: Agents no longer fail after 5 minutes of work. A step is only treated as stuck when Claude goes quiet for 5 minutes, and time spent running tests, rendering, transcribing or waiting on your approval doesn't count. If an agent does get stuck or Claude Code crashes, it starts afresh and carries on from where it left off (up to twice) instead of failing.

done.title: Jarvis can watch videos
done.detail: Send Jarvis or any agent a YouTube/TikTok/Instagram link or a video file and ask what happens in it. He looks at frames from across it (more where the shot changes) and reads what's said (the video's captions, or a transcript made on the PC), then can zoom into any part. Built like the popular claude-video and claude-real-video projects, with no extra keys.

done.title: Less Claude usage
done.detail: Ghostwriter now checks your inbox for free before waking Claude, and Trade Analyst skips days with no trades, so empty checks cost nothing. Scheduled jobs replay less history, email checks carry fewer and shorter emails, and Jarvis starts a fresh conversation once it gets large instead of re-reading it all on every step. The Usage tab shows how many jobs were skipped.

done.title: Chef agent
done.detail: Suggests breakfast, lunch and dinner every morning at 7:30 and writes full recipes, saving each to your cookbook. Remembers your allergies, restrictions, likes and dislikes and how each recipe went, so it gets more tailored over time. Recipes with an ingredient you're allergic to are blocked.

done.title: Morning report and the Changes tab
done.detail: This list on the dashboard, a 9am report in the feed when something's new, and scheduled setup jobs Jarvis runs on his own (like today's 11am add-on install).

done.title: Claude Code add-ons (PR #16)
done.detail: A setup script for your own Claude Code: Anthropic's document skills, Superpowers, code-review, hookify, Python checking, Context7, read-only GitHub and a status line. Jarvis says when Claude Code is waiting on you, and a guard blocks deleting whole drives. Trade Analyst and Portfolio Advisor get market news, indicators and fundamentals; Job Hunter and Travel Planner can read JavaScript-heavy pages.

done.title: Caveman test (PR #15)
done.detail: For 3 days, half of Claude's sessions answer tersely. The Usage tab compares the cost, and the results go to your phone at the end.

done.title: Jarvis remembers things on his own (PR #14)
done.detail: He quietly saves useful things you mention (people, preferences, plans, deadlines) and updates old notes. Never passwords, codes or full card or ID numbers.

done.title: See which agents are working (PR #13)
done.detail: A spinning ring and sparks around busy agents in the 3D view, and a cog on their label; idle ones dim.

done.title: Agent upgrades (PR #12)
done.detail: Travel Planner became a Chase and Amex points expert with daily deal scans. Job Hunter searches 3 times a day and only pings you for strong matches. Video Editor is tuned for TikTok and Reels and can bring in helpers. Telegram got quieter, the feed skips step-by-step messages, every bigger task gets its own agent, and your voice and Telegram chats show on the dashboard.

done.title: Attach files on the dashboard (PR #11)
done.detail: Upload files with a command or a message to an agent.

done.title: Team restarts cleanly (PR #10)
done.detail: Restarting the agent team no longer creates duplicate specialists.

done.title: Talk to agents from General (PR #9)
done.detail: Send files and messages to any agent by name from the main Telegram chat.

done.title: Video Editor agent (PR #8)
done.detail: Plus photos, videos and text files for every agent.

done.title: Faster responses (PR #7)
done.detail: Quicker replies in Telegram and by voice: speech starts sooner, Telegram replies stream in, instant commands for apps and timers.

done.title: Dashboard tabs, themes, sign-in and Travel Planner (PR #6)
done.detail: Tabs for tasks, sessions, usage, projects, the PC and memory; 3 new themes; a password sign-in for the website; and the Travel Planner agent.

done.title: Smaller fixes (PRs #2, #4, #5)
done.detail: /off on Telegram works, windows move between screens without asking, and the phone hears when Jarvis is back after an update.

done.title: The agent team (PRs #1, #3)
done.detail: A team led by Jarvis with its own Telegram topics, coders and a Reviewer, plus always-on specialists: Ghostwriter, Trade Analyst, Portfolio Advisor, Real Estate Advisor and Job Hunter.

done.title: 3D dashboard
done.detail: A live, interactive dashboard with several 3D themes, reachable from your phone over Tailscale.

done.title: Smarter and more reliable
done.detail: A backup brain for when Claude is unreachable, a voice lock that only answers you, real browser control, background tasks, and quicker first words.

done.title: Phone control and memory
done.detail: A private Telegram bot, files between PC and phone, Spotify, Google Calendar, long-term memory, and 'update yourself'.

done.title: The basics
done.detail: Voice control of apps, windows, monitors and folders, interrupting and correcting Jarvis, and changing his voice.

planned.title: Install the Claude Code add-ons
planned.detail: Jarvis updates himself and runs the add-on setup on his own at 11am (or as soon as he's on after that), then reports here and on your phone.

planned.title: Measure the usage savings
planned.detail: Compare a week of the Usage tab before and after, together with the Caveman results, and decide on next steps: a cheaper model for some agents, loading Jarvis's tool list only when needed.

planned.title: Organise the PC's files
planned.detail: Starts with a few questions. Then a read-only survey, a proposed folder layout for you to approve, and moves with a dry run first, a log and an undo, never deleting anything.

planned.title: Caveman test results
planned.detail: The comparison goes to your phone, and you decide whether to keep Caveman on.

planned.title: Your to-dos
planned.detail: Tell the Chef your allergies, restrictions and favourite foods (it'll ask). A free Alpha Vantage key in .env (ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY). A read-only GitHub token (setup_addons.py asks for it). Google connectors at claude.ai > Settings > Connectors. Gmail app password and TradeLog settings. code_repos.json and GITHUB_TOKEN for the coders. Set the PC's sleep to Never so it's always reachable.

planned.title: On hold: Jarvis on the Mac
planned.detail: Shelved so the PC and Mac don't interfere with each other. The PC stays the one host.
